transcript_path.description: Path to the conversation JSON. Written asynchronously, so it can lag the current turn; on Stop and SubagentStop read last_assistant_message instead.

cwd.description: Working directory when the hook is invoked. Follows Claude into a worktree or after a cd, while CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR stays at the project root where the session started.

prompt_id.description: UUID of the user prompt being processed; matches the prompt.id attribute on OpenTelemetry events. Absent until the first user input.

scratchpad_dir.description: Path to the session's scratchpad directory. Absent when the session has none or the temp directory is unavailable. Claude Code 2.1.257 or later.

permission_mode.description: Current permission mode. The mode labelled Manual arrives as default. Not every event carries this field.

level.description: The effort level that ran, including a skill's, subagent's or ultrathink level. CLAUDE_EFFORT holds the same value.

effort.description: Present on events with a tool-use context, on models that support effort.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the subagent or in-process teammate the hook fires in.

agent_type.description: Agent name, such as Explore or a plugin-scoped my-plugin:reviewer. Present inside a subagent, or when the session runs with --agent; a subagent's type wins over the session's.

stop_hook_active.description: true when Claude Code is already continuing because of a stop hook. Check it before blocking again; after eight continuations in a row Claude Code overrides the block.

last_assistant_message.description: The text of the final response. Use it instead of reading transcript_path, which can lag the turn.

type.description: A task-type label such as shell, subagent, monitor, workflow, teammate, cloud session or MCP task.

command.description: Shell command line. Only for shell tasks and monitor tasks that run a command.

agent_type.description: Subagent type name. Only for subagent tasks.

server.description: MCP server name. Only for monitor and MCP task tasks.

tool.description: MCP tool name. Only for monitor and MCP task tasks.

name.description: Workflow name. Only for workflow tasks.

background_tasks.description: The session's in-flight background tasks; empty when nothing is running. With session_crons it tells a finished session from one paused waiting for background work.

recurring.description: false for a one-shot wakeup, true for a task that fires on every match.

prompt.description: The prompt submitted when the cron fires, capped at 1000 characters.

session_crons.description: The session's scheduled wakeups, from CronCreate, ScheduleWakeup and /loop.

title: Stop hook input
description: The main agent finished responding. Does not run after a user interrupt; an API error fires StopFailure instead. No matcher.
